content:
Dev Patel: Escalation: marketplace buyer stuck in provisioning ("Waiting for entitlement"). They subscribed via AWS Marketplace ~2+ hrs ago and still can’t create an org / API key. Customer is Northpeak Analytics (enterprise trial via marketplace).

Dev Patel: Jira: SUP-4821 https://jira.redwoodinference.com/browse/SUP-4821

Dev Patel: Symptoms per ticket:
- Console onboarding -> "We couldn’t verify your marketplace entitlement yet" (retry loop)
- They can sign in, but the marketplace entrypoint never links subscription -> org
- AE/SE is on the call and customer’s procurement is watching :grimacing:

Rachel Kim: Ugh. Do we have their org already created or net-new?

Dev Patel: Net-new as far as I can tell. No existing org in console.

Markus Klein: I’m on the Zoom. They subscribed from AWS account ending in 9041 (per screenshot). They have the subscription confirmation in AWS Marketplace.

Chloe Martin: That error is specifically when `/marketplace/entitlements/verify` returns `NOT_FOUND` (or `PENDING`) for AWS. If it’s been 2h, we should check the sync job + the raw entitlement lookup.

Ethan Park: Can someone paste the subscription identifier / customerIdentifier from AWS side? Without that we’re guessing.

Markus Klein: They don’t see a "customerIdentifier" in the UI, but they can download the subscription agreement. I asked them to grab the "Entitlement" page screenshot too.

Dev Patel: In SUP-4821 I added the screenshot they sent. It includes Product Code `redwood-inference-prod-aws` and the AWS account ID, but not the customerIdentifier.

Jira Cloud: SUP-4821 updated by Dev Patel: "Added customer screenshots + confirmed AWS acct ending 9041; still pending after 2h."

Priya Natarajan: If AWS is delayed we can do the manual mitigation: create org, temporarily grant a Hosted entitlement (time-boxed), then reconcile once entitlement lands. But we need to be careful on metering.

Nadia Rahman: +1. Also want to capture telemetry for this case (entitlement lookup latency + retry counts). If someone can share the request_id from console, I can trace.

Chloe Martin: Console shows request_id in the error modal if you click "Details". Markus can ask for it.

Markus Klein: Got it. Asking now.

Ethan Park: Meanwhile I’ll check entitlement sync logs for AWS around now. What region is their org trying to provision in? (console defaults us-east-1)

Dev Patel: They’re in us-east-1. They didn’t change anything.

Ethan Park: Checking… I see repeated retries for AWS entitlement sync with `AccessDeniedException` for `ResolveCustomer` starting ~30 min ago. That would explain NOT_FOUND everywhere.

Priya Natarajan: That’s bad. Is this the IAM/webhook config regression from last week?

Ethan Park: Possibly. It’s coming from the marketplace sync service role. I’ll page Platform on-call after I confirm.

Dev Patel: For customer comms: can I tell them we’re seeing an internal entitlement sync issue and we’re working it? Need an ETA.

Chloe Martin: Yes, but offer workaround: we can provision them manually so they can start testing today.

Priya Natarajan: Approved. Dev, proceed with manual provision + temp Hosted access (24h) to unblock. Note in SUP ticket and tag Billing for later reconciliation.

Dev Patel: OK. Manual mitigation steps I’ll follow:
1) Create Redwood org for Northpeak (name: Northpeak Analytics)
2) Link user to org
3) Apply temporary Hosted SKU entitlement (24h) + conservative rate limits
4) Send them API key creation steps + marketplace linking page for later

Dev Patel: Chloe/Ethan, anything special to avoid breaking later linking when AWS entitlement is fixed?

Chloe Martin: Yes: don’t mark it as marketplace-linked in the org metadata. Just grant a normal Hosted entitlement. Once entitlement sync is healthy, they can go through marketplace linking and we’ll attach subscription -> org (we have a "link existing org" path).

Ethan Park: +1. Also note: once the AWS entitlement lands, the org should attach to the correct subscription. If they create a second org accidentally, it becomes a mess.

Rachel Kim: Markus, make sure they DO NOT keep clicking create/retry and accidentally start multiple flows. Tell them we’re provisioning and they’ll get an email.

Markus Klein: Copy. Also got request_id from console: `mp_onboard_req_7f3d2a91c6b8`. Sharing here.

Nadia Rahman: Traced. That request maps to entitlement verify returning `AWS_RESOLVE_CUSTOMER_ACCESS_DENIED`. So root cause is definitely IAM permission on sync service.

Ethan Park: I’m paging Platform on-call now and linking SUP-4821. We should also open an internal incident if this affects multiple customers.

Dev Patel: I’ll update SUP-4821 with mitigation + request_id + suspected root cause.

Jira Cloud: SUP-4821 updated by Dev Patel: "Workaround approved: manual org provision + temp Hosted entitlement (24h). Root cause suspected: AWS ResolveCustomer AccessDenied in entitlement sync. Console request_id mp_onboard_req_7f3d2a91c6b8."

Priya Natarajan: Once Platform has the IAM fix, let’s add a postmortem note: why did this not alert earlier? Nadia, can we add an alert on `AWS_RESOLVE_CUSTOMER_ACCESS_DENIED` > threshold.

Nadia Rahman: Yes. I’ll create a follow-up (ENG) after this thread. For now I’ll set a temporary dashboard alert.

Dev Patel: Manual org created + user invited. Markus, I DM’d you the org slug and the steps to get them an API key.

Markus Klein: Confirmed on call: they’re in, API key created, first request succeeded. Procurement is happy again :thumbsup:

Chloe Martin: Great. Please remind them to come back and complete marketplace linking once we resolve entitlement sync, otherwise billing won’t route through AWS Marketplace.

Dev Patel: Will do. Leaving SUP-4821 open until entitlement sync is healthy and we’ve confirmed marketplace linking works end-to-end.

Ethan Park: Platform on-call acknowledged. They’re rolling back the IAM policy change and will redeploy entitlement sync. I’ll post once we see ResolveCustomer succeed.

Ethan Park: Update: ResolveCustomer calls are succeeding again. Entitlement sync is catching up. Expect AWS entitlements to appear within ~15-30 min.

Dev Patel: Noted. I’ll follow up with Northpeak tomorrow to link subscription -> existing org and close SUP-4821.
